nom: Origins Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin generally report a thorough, oil-controlling clean, though some note the wash can feel tight or drying and one reports a severe breakout episode after long-term use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: many say it cleans without stripping or tightness, while several others say it dries out their skin and recommend following with a moisturizer or toner.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers frequently describe the wash as balancing, cleaning oily zones without over-drying, though one found it too drying on her drier zones (chin, forehead).
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation or stinging even around the eyes, but a few warn the essential oils/menthol can leave sensitive skin dry or prone to slight tingling.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 40s-50s report the wash helps manage adult acne and hormonal breakouts while keeping skin from feeling stripped, with one noting it works better now than it did in her 20s.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s-50s report the cleanser fits well into an anti-aging routine, keeping skin clear and not dry despite age-related changes; no complaints specific to aging are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the wash does not leave skin feeling tight, dry, or stripped, but a notable minority (including dry and combination skin users) report dryness or the need to moisturize immediately after use.
concerns.redness: Only one reviewer with rosacea reports improvement; no other redness-specific complaints or irritation are described elsewhere.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe a stinging or tingling sensation and occasional over-stripping with frequent use, while others emphasize it never disrupts their skin's natural moisture; one reviewer reports the older formula badly disrupted her barrier over 9 months.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report the wash clears or controls acne and hormonal breakouts, including one who says it resolved a severe adult breakout within days; one reviewer, however, reports her worst acne flare occurred while using it.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers repeatedly credit the wash with reducing blemishes, minimizing visible pores, and preventing new breakouts over long-term use, with virtually no dissent on this point.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently describe the wash as effective at cutting through excess oil and sunscreen residue without leaving a greasy after-feel, with one exception reporting oil rebound after discontinuing long-term use.

extraits.titre: Happily leaving this cleanser in the past
extraits.texte: I have generally oily/combo skin and hormonal acne that's usually not bad. I used this product for about 9 months and I feel that it absolutely disrupted my skin...stripped and dried it out to the point that once I stopped using it my face was completely overcompensating producing more oil that I felt like my face was constantly wet - not enjoyable. I experienced some of the worst acne I've had in over a decade while using this as well. Have heard that this brand is fine for the body but not the face and I can see why. Do not recommend.

extraits.titre: Nice but not for dry skin
extraits.texte: Smells great and gives that squeaky clean feeling on the skin! However because of the essential oils in the formulation it dried out my dry zones on my combination skin. Might continue to use this product, targeting my areas that are more oily (cheeks/nose) and avoid my drier areas (chin and forehead) but don't know if I want to expend the effort of using two different washes. Won't be repurchasing because I need something for my whole face not because it was a bad product.

extraits.titre: Best face wash I have ever had
extraits.texte: Suffer from combination skin, rosacea, acne, and now aging. This has helped clear my skin better than any other product I have tried in 30 years. Wish I had found it sooner. I use the mega bright moisturizer with it and an occasional face mask like original skin and my face is healtheir now than when I was in my 20's.

extraits.titre: Cleared bad acne outbreak in days
extraits.texte: I suddenly had the worst acne outbreak of my life and none of my regular skincare products worked to clear it. I've always had oily skin and now my skin is even oilier. I tried acne patches, gentle cleansers, acne cleansers, toners, you name it. Everything seemed to make my acne worse! Even my luxury brand 5% benzoyl peroxide acne lotion that has worked for 15 years didn't work in this case. I'm in my early 40s and can only imagine it's caused by hormonal changes from perimenopause. Literally, my face had angry red spots all over and I found new acne and clogged pores daily! I also pick at my skin which doesn't help. So, I cut out all of my products except for the acne lotion but I had to find a good cleanser. Out of desperation, I tried this cleanser. Within DAYS, my acne was clearing up and healing!! It did make my skin feel a bit tight, but it is keeping the oil and acne under control! I was surprised at how well this worked because I remember using it in my 20s and it gave me clogged pores. I guess it depends on your age and how your skin changes overtime. Maybe Origins changed the ingredients since then and improved the formula. I don't know, but it has saved my skin!!!

extraits.titre: So Far I am loving IT!
extraits.texte: I usually do not write reviews. I have extremely sensitive skin and have tried a lot of drug store face washes as well as high end face washes and so far I am on day 4 and am loving this face wash. The tiniest amount goes the longest way (seriously). The cleanser foams up and rinses off well leaving no residue. It does not sting my under eyes or anywhere more sensitive. Highly recommend trying this product if you are in the market for a new face wash.

This is literally the only wash that clears my acne. I have bought over 20 different face cleansers and only this one fully clears my acne. If you have normal skin with no ance this will dry your skin. But it's perfect for ance.

extraits.titre: Works well on my middle-age, oily, acne-prone skin!
extraits.texte: I'm 54 and have been battling excess oil and acne since I was in my teens. I've tried nearly every cleanser and facial care product under the sun over the years trying to find a holy grail product to give my clear, oil-free skin. While this product isn't a holy grail, it does come close. I received a free sample of this about a year ago, tried it, liked it, and promptly forgot about it because life is busy. When it came up during the Ulta 21 Days of Beauty at half price, I figured I'd give the full-size product a go. I do use DHC cleansing oil to remove makeup before cleansing with the Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash. The texture and color remind me of good old Noxema, (If you know, you know) but with nowhere near the strong scent. It has a faint, slightly spearmint scent that isn't overpowering at all. I do apply it with a facial exfoliating sponge (buff puff, for lack of a better term) because I do use rx retinoid on my skin to help with acne and oil, and I do get the occasional flakiness. The Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash lives up to the name. It only takes a pea sized amount, but it does foam up nicely. I lightly exfoliate while cleansing and the lather is very creamy to the touch and pleasant. It's definitely a mild to the skin cleanser with no stinging or burning. It rinses easily and you're left with no residue and very clean feeling skin, but not so clean that it's been stripped completely of natural oils. I love the way my skin feels after using this and
